definition: The fictional adventure role Luffy vows to become in the VIZ Volume 1 premise.
cultural_caution: A source-specific fictional role, not a mapping to historical or contemporary piracy, colonial systems, maritime law, nationality, or criminal classification.

definition: The aspirational pirate title Luffy vows to attain in the selected VIZ synopsis.
cultural_caution: An in-world fictional ambition/title, not evidence of a historical sovereign office, actual rule, or later achievement.

definition: The named fruit Luffy accidentally eats, which VIZ says gives him rubber-like stretching power at the cost of never being able to swim again.
cultural_caution: A source-specific fictional object/power premise. It is not a full Devil Fruit taxonomy, a real food or medical claim, or evidence for any later power system such as Haki.

supports: fruit name, accidental consumption, stretching ability, and inability-to-swim cost

definition: The category phrase present in the name of the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit in the VIZ Volume 1 synopsis.
cultural_caution: Only the named Gum-Gum instance and its stated effects are supported here. The phrase is not expanded into a complete category, theological claim, or later-franchise system.

definition: The legendary treasure Luffy seeks, described by VIZ as said to be the greatest treasure in the world.
cultural_caution: An item/objective, not a character endpoint. No origin, location, ownership history, nature, or resolution is inferred from the opening synopsis.

supports: One Piece as the legendary greatest-treasure objective
